en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al Husayn Bin Nuaym Al Sahhaf who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about His<sup>azwj</sup> Words
[64:2] so among you is an unbeliever and among you is a Believer.

So heasws said: ‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Recognised their Eman by their Wilayah for usasws and their disbelief with it on the day Heazwj Took the Covenant upon them, and they were particles in the ‘Sulb’ of Adamas’.
And I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the Words of the Mighty and Majestic
[64:12] And obey Allah and obey the Rasool, but if you turn back, then upon Our Rasool devolves only the clear delivery (of the Message).

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! The ones before you were not destroyed and the ones who are destroyed until the rising of Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup> will not be destroyed except with regards to neglecting our<sup>asws</sup> Wilayah, and denying our<sup>asws</sup> rights; and Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> did not exit from the world until he<sup>saww</sup> necessitated the necks of this community to our<sup>asws</sup> rights.
[2:213] and Allah Guides whom He so Desires to, to the Straight Path’.
en.sarwar: 74. Muhammad ibn al-Hassan and Ali ibn Muhammad have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Musa ibn al-Qasim al-Bajaliy from Ali ibn Ja‘far from his brother Musa (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most High. “. . their lofty mansions, all were toppled and their wells were left idle.” [22:45] The Imam (a.s.) said, “The abandoned well and idle well refers to the silent Imam and lofty mansion refers to the speaking Imam.” Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated a similar hadith from al-‘Amrakifm Ali ibn Ja‘far from abu al-Hassan (a.s.).
